description: Cancels a booking, or declines a request (two steps: the first call returns confirm_token and what happens; the second, after the user agrees, emails the customer). series "rest": every later date too. A waitlist entry_id (wl_…) takes that person off. whole_class: cancels the whole class time, one email each.

close_waitlist.description: A class booking: nobody waiting is offered the place; they are told no place will open

confirm_token.description: From the first call, after the user's yes

notify_customer.description: Email the customer (default true when there is an email)

series.description: "this" (default) or "rest" (this date and every later one)

whole_class.description: A class booking: cancel this class time for everyone booked in, in one step

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
